description: plans ordered bounded chunks from item count and chunk size using only bounded caller-supplied values. Call when you need a bounded batch chunk plan result before an agent hands structured data or a batch plan to a downstream tool with a stricter contract. Returns the bounded transformation or validation finding with counts, normalized values, and a versioned result contract for Batch Chunk Plan as versioned deterministic JSON. Limitation: Processes bounded caller-supplied data in memory only; it performs no file fetch, database write, code execution, or retention.

chunk_size.description: Chunk Size supplied to Batch Chunk Plan; used only for this bounded calculation and processed in memory without retention.

item_count.description: Item Count supplied to Batch Chunk Plan; used only for this bounded calculation and processed in memory without retention.

name: util_batch_chunk_plan
